sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: For the first time in nearly a decade,
sentences.zh: 近十年来首次，

sentences.en: President Trump will meet with China's president Xi Jinping in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统将在北京会见中国国家主席习近平。

sentences.en: The meeting comes as Trump struggles to extract himself from the war with Iran.
sentences.zh: 此次会晤正值特朗普努力从与伊朗的战争中脱身之际。

sentences.en: And must now face off against China, the biggest threat to the U.S.'s dominance on everything from technology to trade.
sentences.zh: 他现在必须面对中国，这是美国在从技术到贸易等各个领域主导地位的最大威胁。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Sanger explains what's likely to come of this meeting and more pressingly, what will not.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·桑格将解释这次会晤可能会达成什么，更紧迫的是，不会达成什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月13日，星期三。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: David, we can hear you.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们能听到。

sentences.en: Where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: Good, good, good.
sentences.zh: 好，好，好。

sentences.en: I'm in my hotel in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 我在北京的酒店里。

sentences.en: I just arrived with several of my Washington Bureau colleagues and we are all preparing for the president arriving for his first trip to China in the second term.
sentences.zh: 我刚和几位华盛顿分社的同事抵达，我们都在为总统第二任期内首次访华做准备。

sentences.en: He'll get in on Wednesday night and meet Xi Jinping the next morning and part of Friday before he just turns around and goes right back home.
sentences.zh: 他将于周三晚上抵达，次日上午会见习近平，周五还会待一会儿，然后就直接回国了。

sentences.en: Okay, so now that you're in Beijing, can you set the scene for us a little bit, David?
sentences.zh: 好的，既然你已经在北京了，大卫，能为我们介绍一下背景吗？

sentences.en: Like, what is the significance of this meeting between President Trump and Xi Jinping?
sentences.zh: 比如，特朗普总统和习近平主席这次会晤的意义何在？

sentences.en: Well, as initially conceived, Rachel, this was going to be the first of a series of meetings this year in an effort by the president to have something of a rapprochement with the
sentences.zh: 嗯，瑞秋，最初的设想是，这将是今年一系列会晤中的第一次，是总统试图与

sentences.en: Chinese after many, many years of tension.
sentences.zh: 中国在经历多年紧张关系后实现某种程度的和解。

sentences.en: The last time the president was here was 2017, and it was a very different situation.
sentences.zh: 总统上次来这里是2017年，当时的情况非常不同。

sentences.en: The president was treated with all the pageantry that the Chinese do very well.
sentences.zh: 总统受到了中国非常擅长的各种礼仪接待。

sentences.en: President Xi, I want to thank you for that incredible welcoming ceremony.
sentences.zh: 习近平主席，我要感谢您那场令人难以置信的欢迎仪式。

sentences.en: He had just been elected president to the surprise of China and the world and perhaps himself.
sentences.zh: 他当时刚当选总统，这让中国、世界甚至他自己都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Today, I discussed with President Xi the chronic imbalance in our relationship as it pertains to trade.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与习近平主席讨论了我们关系中长期存在的贸易失衡问题。

sentences.en: He was just beginning to think about how China correlated with his economic policies and his defense policies.
sentences.zh: 他当时才刚开始思考中国如何与他的经济政策和国防政策相协调。

sentences.en: The United States is committed to protecting the intellectual property of our companies and providing a level playing field.
sentences.zh: 美国致力于保护我们公司的知识产权，并提供公平的竞争环境。

sentences.en: And was going to focus on China's rise as a major power.
sentences.zh: 并且当时正准备关注中国作为一个大国的崛起。

sentences.en: In the coming months and years, I look forward to building an even stronger relationship between our two countries, China and the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 在未来的岁月里，我期待着在我们两国，即中国和美利坚合众国之间建立更牢固的关系。

sentences.en: But this time he arrives under the cloud of the Iran conflict.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他是在伊朗冲突的阴影下抵达的。

sentences.en: You'll remember he was supposed to come here in April and put it off.
sentences.zh: 你还记得他本应在四月来这里，但推迟了。

sentences.en: And did so, I think, fairly convinced that by mid-May, Iran would have already capitulated.
sentences.zh: 他推迟了，我想是因为他相当确信到五月中旬，伊朗就已经投降了。

sentences.en: And now instead he shows up with Iran resisting, with other world leaders like Chancellor Mertz of Germany
sentences.zh: 而现在，伊朗仍在抵抗，像德国默茨总理这样的世界领导人也

sentences.en: contending that Iran has humiliated the United States, and with the Chinese themselves a bit mystified about why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 认为伊朗羞辱了美国，而且中国人自己也对美国为何在打开霍尔木兹海峡这样的水域，

sentences.en: was having such a hard time opening up a body of water such as the Strait of Hormuz or defeating a kind of second- or third-rate power in their mind like Iran.
sentences.zh: 或者击败像伊朗这样在他们看来二三流的国家时遇到如此大的困难感到困惑。

sentences.en: And of course, all summits are about optics.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有的峰会都是为了形象工程。

sentences.en: And while I'm sure there will be all the pomp and ceremony that goes with these, the fact of the matter is he comes into this summit looking a bit weakened.
sentences.zh: 虽然我肯定会有随之而来的所有排场和仪式，但事实是他参加这次峰会时显得有些虚弱。

sentences.en: Okay, so I understand that Donald Trump is walking into these meetings much weaker than in 2017.
sentences.zh: 好的，我明白唐纳德·特朗普参加这些会议时比2017年虚弱得多。

sentences.en: But as for the meeting itself, what do we know, if anything, about what they're actually going to be discussing?
sentences.zh: 但就会议本身而言，如果有什么消息的话，我们知道他们实际上要讨论什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, we don't know a huge amount right now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们目前了解得并不多。

sentences.en: But the obvious in any summit that involves President Trump is that you begin with the trade and economic relationships.
sentences.zh: 但在涉及特朗普总统的任何峰会中，显而易见的是，你总是从贸易和经济关系开始。

sentences.en: And there, there's almost always a series of big purchases by China to be announced and potential business deals
sentences.zh: 在那里，几乎总会有一系列中国宣布的大额采购和潜在的商业交易，

sentences.en: and memorandums of understanding, some of which will come to fruition and some of which will not.
sentences.zh: 以及谅解备忘录，其中一些会实现，而另一些则不会。

sentences.en: But these are all sort of the well-hanging fruit of the relationship.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是这种关系中所谓的“低垂果实”。

sentences.en: I mean, this is what Donald Trump would do in any big summit meeting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是唐纳德·特朗普在任何大型峰会上都会做的事情。

sentences.en: And in some ways, those may be the easier of the issues to resolve, which isn't to say that any of them are easy.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这些可能是更容易解决的问题，但这并不是说它们很容易。

sentences.en: Well, can we dive into that a little bit more?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们能深入探讨一下吗？

sentences.en: Like when you say low-hanging fruit, trade, business, what are we talking about exactly?
sentences.zh: 比如当你提到低垂果实、贸易、商业时，我们具体在谈论什么？

sentences.en: Well, Rachel, this is Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，瑞秋，这就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And his idea of a summit is to emerge with a bunch of business deals, even if they don't fundamentally change the nature of the relationship.
sentences.zh: 他心目中的峰会就是带着一堆商业交易出现，即使这些交易并没有从根本上改变两国关系的性质。

sentences.en: And he set this one up just that way.
sentences.zh: 他就是这样安排这次会议的。

sentences.en: And so you'll hear a lot about the three Bs, beef, beans, and Boeing.
sentences.zh: 所以你会听到很多关于“三个B”的内容：牛肉（Beef）、大豆（Beans）和波音（Boeing）。

sentences.en: Why beans, beef, and Boeing?
sentences.zh: 为什么是大豆、牛肉和波音？

sentences.en: Well, these are three big, distinctly American exports.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是三种大型的、典型的美国出口产品。

sentences.en: The Chinese have always bought American soybeans, although they think they're overpriced.
sentences.zh: 中国人一直购买美国大豆，尽管他们认为价格过高。

sentences.en: They've long been dependent on Boeing, although now they're building some very good aircraft of their own.
sentences.zh: 他们长期以来一直依赖波音，尽管现在他们也在制造一些非常好的飞机。

sentences.en: And beef, well, they're trying to start up their own beef industry as well, but they're still buying some specialty American beef.
sentences.zh: 至于牛肉，嗯，他们也在尝试建立自己的养牛业，但他们仍在购买一些美国特产牛肉。

sentences.en: These are always the low-hanging fruit of these summits, because China needs to buy some of this anyway.
sentences.zh: 这些总是这些峰会上的低垂果实，因为无论如何中国都需要购买其中的一些。

sentences.en: And the president wants to be able to go out and describe something that is an immediate deliverable to the American people.
sentences.zh: 而总统希望能够走出去，向美国人民描述一些立竿见影的成果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The president doesn't need to fly halfway across the world to negotiate something that China was just going to buy anyway.
sentences.zh: 总统不需要飞越半个地球去谈判一些中国无论如何都会购买的东西。

sentences.en: I'm sure that you'll hear many announcements, and the president will declare that these were the biggest purchases ever.
sentences.zh: 我相信你会听到很多公告，总统会宣布这些是有史以来最大的采购。

sentences.en: But they are fundamentally commodities.
sentences.zh: 但它们本质上是大宗商品。

sentences.en: And that's where the two countries do business most easily.
sentences.zh: 而这正是两国最容易开展业务的地方。

sentences.en: But, you know, one thing that I did not hear you discuss in your discussion of the three Bs, David, was a pretty big T that we've been talking about on the show a lot,
sentences.zh: 但是，大卫，你在讨论“三个B”时，有一件我没听到你讨论的事情，那就是我们在节目中经常谈论的一个很大的“T”，

sentences.en: and that is tariffs.
sentences.zh: 那就是关税（Tariffs）。

sentences.en: Where does that fit into all of this?
sentences.zh: 这在所有这些中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, tariffs are a huge issue for the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然，关税对中国人来说是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: China's been a big target of Trump's tariff regime, and I'm sure that it will dominate a lot of the discussion.
sentences.zh: 中国一直是特朗普关税制度的主要目标，我相信这也会主导很多讨论。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is the Chinese were able to get President Trump to back down some last year when, in retaliation,
sentences.zh: 但事实是，去年当中国采取报复措施时，他们成功地让特朗普总统做出了一些让步，

sentences.en: they cut off rare earths and magnets and so forth to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们切断了对美国的稀土和磁铁供应等等，

sentences.en: to demonstrate that they, too, have a bit of leverage here.
sentences.zh: 以证明他们在这里也有一点筹码。

sentences.en: And then came the Supreme Court decision, which forced the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后是最高法院的裁决，迫使美国

sentences.en: to pay back some of the tariffs that have already been collected.
sentences.zh: 退还了一些已经征收的关税。

sentences.en: And now a trade court decision is going after President Trump's ability to impose a 10% tariff on every country.
sentences.zh: 现在，一家贸易法院的裁决正在挑战特朗普总统对每个国家征收10%关税的能力。

sentences.en: So I think that Xi Jinping probably feels like he's already won half his argument before he starts.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为习近平可能觉得他在开始之前就已经赢了一半的辩论了。

sentences.en: Now, there are some tariffs on specific Chinese products that certainly are a big concern to them.
sentences.zh: 现在，对某些特定中国产品征收的关税确实是他们非常关心的问题。

sentences.en: And here, the biggest example is Chinese cars.
sentences.zh: 这里最大的例子就是中国汽车。

sentences.en: You know, the Chinese, during the president's first term, exported about a million cars a year.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在总统的第一任期内，中国每年出口约一百万辆汽车。

sentences.en: This past year, they've exported around the world 7 million, except to the United States, where they were barred, chiefly by Joe Biden, who put 100% tariff on Chinese cars.
sentences.zh: 去年，他们向全球出口了700万辆，除了美国，因为他们被禁止了，主要是乔·拜登对中国汽车征收了100%的关税。

sentences.en: And that's a big source of complaint on the part of the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 这是中国人抱怨的一个主要来源。

sentences.en: OK, so China is going to want to push to get these cars into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以中国会想要推动让这些汽车进入美国。

sentences.en: Do we expect a deal?
sentences.zh: 我们预计会有协议吗？

sentences.en: No, we do not, because I think everybody recognizes that China's car production capacity is posing a considerable threat to the American carmakers, just as Japan did decades ago.
sentences.zh: 不，我们不预计，因为我认为大家都认识到，中国的汽车生产能力正对美国汽车制造商构成相当大的威胁，就像几十年前日本所做的那样。

sentences.en: But I think what's worth remembering here, Rachel, is these are the immediate trade tensions that take place between countries all the time, with our adversaries, with our allies.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里值得记住的是，瑞秋，这些是国家之间一直发生的即时贸易紧张局势，无论是与我们的对手还是盟友。

sentences.en: But what's frustrating sometimes around these summit meetings is that we all know there are much more fundamental divides between the two countries,
sentences.zh: 但有时围绕这些峰会令人沮丧的是，我们都知道两国之间存在更根本的分歧，

sentences.en: divides that go to the heart of the question of who will be the dominant economic power,
sentences.zh: 这些分歧触及了谁将成为未来几十年主导经济力量、

sentences.en: the dominant military power, the dominant technological power, for the next number of decades.
sentences.zh: 主导军事力量、主导技术力量的核心问题。

sentences.en: And it's not clear whether any of those core issues in the relationship will come up, at least in direct form.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚关系中的任何核心问题是否会浮出水面，至少不会以直接的形式出现。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So David, talk to us about those fundamental divides that are both at the heart of the battle for dominance
sentences.zh: 那么大卫，跟我们谈谈那些既是两国争夺主导权核心，

sentences.en: between these two countries and also potentially unlikely to come up in the meeting this week.
sentences.zh: 又可能不太会在本周会议上提出的根本分歧吧。

sentences.en: Or it's no secret that for the past 10 years, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 或者说，过去10年来，美国和中国一直处于一种有时看起来像是生死搏斗的状态，这已经不是什么秘密了，对吧？

sentences.en: and China have been engaged in what sometimes looks like a bit of a death struggle, right?
sentences.zh: 习近平毫不掩饰这样一个事实：到2049年，他希望中国成为世界第一军事、经济、政治，甚至可能是文化大国。

sentences.en: Xi Jinping has made no secret of the fact that by 2049, he wants China to be the number one military, economic, political, and perhaps even cultural power in the world.
sentences.zh: 而美国将如何应对一个本质上的同等竞争对手的崛起，这是唯一一个能在这些领域全面与我们抗衡的国家，

sentences.en: And the question of how the United States is going to deal with the rise of essentially a peer competitor, the only country that can deal with us across the board in those areas,
sentences.zh: 这是根本性的问题。

sentences.en: is the fundamental question.
sentences.zh: 你在这样的峰会上看到，这在关于各种具体问题的争论中体现出来。

sentences.en: And you're seeing in summits like this that this plays out in arguments about all kinds of specific issues.
sentences.zh: 但总的问题是，你如何应对一个试图取代你成为世界第一强国的国家？

sentences.en: But the overall question is, how do you deal with a country that's trying to displace you as the world's number one power?
sentences.zh: 大卫，其中一些问题是什么？

sentences.en: What are some of those issues, David?
sentences.zh: 带我们了解一下。

sentences.en: Walk us through those.
sentences.zh: 我们从核武器开始。

sentences.en: We'll start with nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 在毛泽东时代以及之后的几十年里，中国一直保持着最低限度的核威慑。

sentences.en: China had under Mao and for many decades after a minimum nuclear deterrent.
sentences.zh: 它保留了100到200枚核武器，足以威慑他人对其进行打击。

sentences.en: It kept 100, 200 nuclear weapons just enough to deter others from striking it.
sentences.zh: 但当习近平上台后，他几乎立即开始了一场巨大的扩充，美国直到几年后才完全意识到这一点。

sentences.en: But when Xi came in, he almost immediately began a huge buildup that the United States didn't really become fully aware of until years later.
sentences.zh: 今天，它拥有大约600枚核武器。

sentences.en: And today, it has about 600 nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 但五角大楼估计，到2030年，中国将拥有约1000枚核武器，并将在2035年左右与美国和俄罗斯持平。

sentences.en: But the Pentagon estimates that China will have about 1,000 nuclear weapons by 2030 and will match the U.S.
sentences.zh: 为什么这很关键？

sentences.en: and Russia by about 2035.
sentences.zh: 因为就在几个月前，正如我们之前在《每日简报》中讨论的那样，俄罗斯和美国之间最后剩下的军控条约到期了。

sentences.en: And why is this critical?
